## Standing operator rules
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` by hand.
- All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use exact metrics label `sms:delivery_attempt`.
- Run `rename_get_user_record` steps in order, one at a time.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. SQLAlchemy upgrade is paused; rename steps remain paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Current staging exports bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; `ledgerly-exports-stg` is superseded, frozen for audit, and must not be written to. Metrics label: `sms:delivery_attempt`. Formatter includes `request_id`, rendering absent context as `null`. Scheduler combines stored date and naive `datetime.time`; patched with `tzinfo=schedule.tzinfo`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate invoices in staging.

## Plan and progress
- [done] SQLAlchemy verification and `rename_get_user_record` procedure steps 1–3.
- [paused] Steps 4–9, one at a time.
- [pending] Implement vendor-credit CSV import.
- Next command: none specified.

## Recent work
Fixed scheduler DST handling, added two regression tests, and verified 31 scheduler/billing tests plus Ruff and whitespace checks. Full suite has one unrelated legacy-rounding failure (`expected 1000, got 1001`). Added five currency-rounding cases; all pass.
